title: Start where ego is finally questioned
summary: Guru Angad turns ego into a question instead of a private identity: where does it arise, and by what discipline does it leave? Defensiveness softens when it is examined under hukam.
takeaway: Ask where ego is rising before you defend it.
lifeApplication: When the face heats or the throat tightens, do not rush to justify the feeling. Let the shabad's question interrupt you: where did this self-importance come from, and what would remove it?

source.shortMeaning: Ego begins to loosen when it is questioned under hukam rather than defended as the self.
source.lifeApplication: When defensiveness rises, ask where ego came from before speaking from it.

evidence.coreClaim: Ego begins to loosen when it is questioned under hukam rather than defended as the self.
evidence.turn: Let the shabad's question make defensiveness answerable before it becomes action.
